description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Golgari Rot Farm.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
